tightening_rationale: Evidence does not support the submitted sentence exactly. 'on a daily schedule' adjacent to 'sends reminders' supports a per-tenant-daily reading the escalation gates disprove (>=14 and >=7 day spacing, at most one stage per run, hard stop after the third message). 'automatically' is explicitly licensed by the copy standard and its absence reopens the cohort-one 'approval on a person' misread. No metric or claim was added; every substituted word maps to committed evidence.
